v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
text.en: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

text.la: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
text.en: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

text.la: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
text.en: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

text.la: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
text.en: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

text.la: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
text.en: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

text.la: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.
text.en: The first verse of the following hymn is said genuflecting.

v.la: Dignáre me laudáre te, Virgo sacráta.
v.en: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be.

r.la: Da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
r.en: Give me strength against thine enemies.

text.la: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Iesu Christo, allelúia.
text.en: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, Spíritus Sancti habitáculum, hodiérna die in templo præsentári voluísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, eius intercessióne, in templo glóriæ tuæ præsentári mereámur.
text.en: O God, Who wast pleased that the blessed Mary always a Virgin, being herself the dwelling-place of the Holy Ghost, should, as on this day, be presented in thine earthly Temple, grant, we beseech thee, that by her prayers we may worthily be presented in the heavenly Temple of thy glory.
